decisions.reason: Although it is related to the firm's nutrients-from-biomass knowledge, a consumer superfood mix is materially less aligned with its strongest absorptive base in industrial process technology, engineering and energy systems, so management would likely reallocate resources to more learnable and scalable core ventures.

This modular extension line builds directly on the firm's established waste-to-energy, automation and prototyping capabilities, giving it strong ability to interpret early market feedback and improve the offer through in-house R&D.
As a flagship product squarely within the firm's core conversion and plant-engineering knowledge base, it fits its absorptive capacity very well and is likely to be refined rather than withdrawn.

Despite technical and market uncertainty, the product is close to the firm's established offer and strategic direction, so its R&D and university links make continued development and retention more likely than exit.
